_note: Verified 2026-08-23. MEDLY AI LIMITED (15110302), 167-169 Great Portland Street, London W1W, incorporated 2023-09-01. Companies House confirms both founders as directors from incorporation and as the company's only persons with significant control: Guyun Jung, who appears in the press as Dr Paul Jung, and Dr Kavitej Singh Samra, who appears as Dr Kavi Samra. Two later directors (Jonathan Coker, Ling Chou) are not founders and are not listed. The 400,000 UK user figure and the February 2025 launch date are press-reported and were not independently verified. Latest capital filing is 2025-12-27, before this round, so the seed is press-corroborated. Public facts only; no contact data.
